title: Theory of Infinite Maximal Green Sequences: Finest Stability Data, CBHO Sequence and Cluster quiver pattern
summary: In this paper, we introduce maximal green sequences of infinite length in abelian length categories and establish natural bijections among infinite maximal green sequences, finest stability data, and complete backward $\operatorname{Hom}$-orthogonal (briefly, CBHO) sequences of bricks. For cluster quiver patterns (equivalently, cluster algebras) of infinite rank, we define maximal green sequences of infinite length via $c$-vectors.
